notes: Counters: THE STRIP -- the + on a counter's page puts it on the strip; PRINT STRIP on the list prints them stacked as one piece with a cut line between (up to eight; hold to clear)
Printer: SWITCH on the PRINTER page goes between the printers you have used (the last three) without a scan -- each keeps its own DARKNESS, LABELS, SPEAKS, PULL BACK and FEED AFTER
Printer: PULL BACK and FEED AFTER set the blank paper before and after a card on the PD01 family
Printer: the PD01 and its family (GB01, MX06, the 'Fun Print' / 'iPrint' printers) print cards over Bluetooth
Game Boy: .gbc games in colour, sound, long file names; Music: the player comes back after an update check
